items.t: 2027 GRIs repeat 5.9%; UPS dates run a few days earlier
items.body: UPS announced its 2027 increase on Oct. 23, 2026, at an average net 5.9% effective Dec. 21, 2026. The 2026 increase was announced Oct. 31, 2025 and took effect Dec. 22, 2025, and the 2025 increase took effect Dec. 23, 2024. FedEx announced its 2027 increase on Sept. 18, 2026, effective Jan. 4, 2027; its average has been 5.9% in each of the 2024 to 2027 cycles, against 4.9% in 2018 to 2021 and 6.9% in 2023.

items.t: USPS: 5.9% for January 2027, after 2026 mid-year changes
items.body: USPS filed on Nov. 12, 2026 and published a final rule on Nov. 19 for prices effective Jan. 17, 2027. Priority Mail Express, Priority Mail and Ground Advantage rise 5.9% overall. The January 2026 change, announced Nov. 14, 2025 and effective Jan. 18, 2026, was Priority Mail about 6.6% and Ground Advantage about 7.8%. In 2026 USPS also made off-cycle changes: a temporary 8% increase from April 26 and a July 12 change averaging 11.8% for Ground Advantage Commercial. Mid-year changes also came in July 2025 (Ground Advantage about 7.1%) and July 2024 (Parcel Select 25%).

items.t: Fuel tables: more off-cycle changes in 2026 than in 2025
items.body: UPS raised its domestic fuel tables on Jan. 5, 2026 (Ground at $3.85 diesel went from 20.75% to 21.75%), again on Mar. 9 (the third increase of 2026), and on Nov. 2. It announced a further 0.50-point rise on Nov. 12, effective Nov. 16. In 2025 UPS made table increases of 0.50 points on Mar. 10 and 1.00 point on May 26, and in June 2025 UPS and FedEx Ground fuel surcharges reached 20%, above the 19.50% FedEx peak of mid-2022. TheStreet reported FedEx's fuel surcharge at 30.5% on Nov. 12, 2026, and FedEx announced a further domestic table update effective Nov. 9, 2026 without stating its size.

items.t: 2026 peak amounts above 2025 at FedEx, UPS and USPS
items.body: FedEx's Nov. 23 to Dec. 27, 2026 window lists Additional Handling at $11.85 (2025: $10.90), Oversize at $117.25 ($108.50) and Ground residential at $0.80 ($0.65). UPS lists Large Package at $96.25 / $117.50 (2025: $90.50 / $107), Over Maximum Limits at $530 / $590 ($485 / $540) and Additional Handling reported at $8.75 / $11.90 ($8.25 / $10.80). USPS's peak surcharge, announced Aug. 25, 2026 and running Oct. 4, 2026 to Jan. 17, 2027, is stacked on the temporary 8%; retail Priority Mail and Ground Advantage Zones 1-4 at 0-3 lb is +$0.50, against +$0.40 in 2025 and +$0.30 in 2024. USPS applied no peak surcharge in 2023.

items.t: Size and handling rules tighten again, as in 2025
items.body: In 2026 FedEx (Jan. 12) and UPS (Jan. 26) added cubic-volume triggers: Additional Handling now applies above 10,368 cubic inches. On July 12, 2026 USPS cut its dimensional-weight divisor from 166 to 139 and began rounding dimensions up to the whole inch; FedEx and UPS adopted whole-unit rounding on Aug. 18, 2025. UPS's Additional Handling minimum billable weight, set at 40 lb in the 2025 increase, goes to 50 lb on Dec. 21, 2026, and an analysis says all 20 of the most common UPS surcharges rise more than 5.9%, averaging 9.1%.

items.t: New in 2026: a USPS fuel surcharge and per-pound surge fees
items.body: For the January 2021 change, USPS noted no surcharges for fuel, residential delivery or regular Saturday delivery. On Nov. 12, 2026 it filed to replace the temporary 8% April charge with a permanent 11% fuel surcharge on base postage, effective Jan. 17, 2027, pending Postal Regulatory Commission review. Separately, UPS added per-pound Surge Emergency Fees in 2026 (for example $1.34/lb U.S.-Middle East from Mar. 22, and China/Hong Kong/Macau to U.S. rising from $0.91 to $1.03 on Nov. 16), and FedEx added per-pound demand fees on Zone K from Mar. 5 and Vietnam imports from Nov. 2; in 2025 international peak fees ran $0.10 to $0.52 per lb.
